Welcome to Coaching With Dr. Alicia

We believe that true healing begins from within.

Our mission is to help individuals reconnect with their emotional balance, nurture self-love, and create space for peace through intentional self-care. Founded with compassion and purpose, our brand blends emotional wellness coaching with holistic self-care products — empowering you to restore calm, confidence, and clarity in your daily life.

Life can be demanding, and it's easy to lose touch with your inner peace. That's why we created Healing With Dr. Alicia — a space designed to support your healing journey, one mindful ritual at a time.

Reconnect

Come back to yourself — your needs, your truth, your worth.

Restore

Rebuild emotional balance and rediscover your inner calm.

Relax

Nourish your body and mind with intentional, clean self-care rituals.

Reclaim

Step fully into your confidence, joy, and sense of peace.
